blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 8 sold over 4 months against an average of 15.5 listed, about 7.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 3 sold. Condos and townhomes: 2 sold over 4 months against an average of 7.8 listed, about 15.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 1 sold.

faq.q: What and where is Thornhill, Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Thornhill is a City of Maple Ridge neighbourhood and the board/Paragon sub-area name for the heavily forested, mainly residential hillside in east Maple Ridge, with farms and nurseries and a 17-trail mountain-biking and hiking network on 256 Street.

faq.q: How did Thornhill sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Quietly: detached recorded 13 active listings, 1 sold and an 8% sales ratio, while Condos & Townhomes recorded 8 listings and 0 solds, so no sales ratio applies to the attached split (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

The live page names Whonnock Elementary (27471 112 Avenue), Albion Elementary (10031 240 Street), Blue Mountain Elementary (12453 248 Street per the BC Ministry K-12 file), Samuel Robertson Technical Secondary (10445 245 Street) and Garibaldi Secondary (24789 Dewdney Trunk Road); catchments are address-specific — check any address in the SD42 School Locator.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Thornhill?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses listed with 1 sold in the month and 8 condos and townhomes listed with 0 sold in the month in Thornhill. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Thornhill a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 8%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
